description: Land Acquisition - Galmangoda & Maaduwa, Balapitiya D/S Division, Galle District and an amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2108/14 of 28/012019, Dambulla D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for acquiring specific land parcels (with lot numbers, descriptions, extents, and boundaries) for public purposes like road widening and school playgrounds. The content focuses entirely on land/property matters without any government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories, making it a clear Land Gazette.
